title: Configurable bank transfer option (admin-managed) with customer modal display

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks to fetch and admin-update bank transfer details via the backend actor, following existing Stripe hook patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a query hook that fetches bank transfer details and caches them via React Query.
There is a mutation hook that updates bank transfer details and invalidates/refetches the cached query on success.
Hook error states are surfaced to the UI so the admin can understand failures (e.g., unauthorized, validation).

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for bank transfer details: a cached query hook calling the backend capability to fetch bank details (getBankRequirements) and a mutation hook calling the backend capability to save bank details (saveBankDetails) with cache invalidation on success; ensure hook errors are returned to consumers so UI can render clear messages.

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only header entry point that opens a dialog to configure and save bank transfer details with validation and clear success/error feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated admin opens the configuration dialog, they can enter and save bank transfer details.
The UI validates required fields (bank name, account name, account number) and shows clear English error messages for missing/invalid inputs.
On successful save, the dialog shows a success confirmation and the saved details are reflected in subsequent reads.
Non-admin users do not see the bank transfer configuration entry point in the header UI.

file_operations.description: Add a small React Query hook to determine whether the current authenticated caller is an admin (via backend capability isCallerAdmin) so the header can reliably hide admin-only bank detail configuration for non-admin users.

Create an admin configuration form component for BankDetails (bankName, accountName, accountNumber required; note optional) that uses existing shadcn-ui form primitives (e.g., Button, Input, Label, Alert) and the new bank detail query/mutation hooks to prefill, validate, save, and show success/error states. Use shadcn-ui Dialog subcomponents for headings where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an admin-only header button/menu entry that opens a shadcn-ui Dialog containing the new BankTransferAdminSetup component; ensure it only renders when the user is authenticated and the admin-check hook returns true. Compose with existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Button components (do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a customer-facing 'Pay via Bank Transfer' action on each plan card that opens a modal showing configured bank details and instructions, without breaking existing Stripe/WhatsApp flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Each plan card offers a clear bank transfer action (e.g., a button) alongside the existing 'Pay Now' and 'Order via WhatsApp' flows.
The bank transfer modal displays bank name, account name, and account number (and optional note if set) in a readable layout, with a copy-friendly presentation (e.g., easy to select/copy).
If bank transfer details are not configured, the bank transfer action is hidden or disabled and the UI explains that bank transfer is currently unavailable (in English).
Adding the bank transfer option does not break the existing Stripe checkout flow or WhatsApp ordering flow for any network-specific plan.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable customer modal component that uses shadcn-ui Dialog (and optional Alert) to present bank transfer details plus a short English instruction block; render bank name/account name/account number prominently with copy-friendly/selectable text presentation and show the optional note only when provided. If details are null/unavailable, show an English 'Bank transfer is currently unavailable' message. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a 'Pay via Bank Transfer' action to each plan card alongside the existing PayNowButton and WhatsApp button; wire it to open the new BankTransferDetailsDialog and source its data from the bank details query hook. If bank details are not configured, disable or hide the action and show an English explanation without affecting existing Stripe checkout or WhatsApp ordering flows. Compose using existing shadcn-ui Button/Dialog components (do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
